MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 6

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 25

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 29

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

14. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

16. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
